Default data_as_elements converts span and div with data-as

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<div><span data-as=\"p\">First</span><span data-as=\"p\">Second</span></div>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
